newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Trading on Bangladesh bourse uncertain due strike.
newsitem.headline: Trading on Bangladesh bourse uncertain due strike.

text.p: Trading on the Dhaka Stock Exchange may not take place on Tuesday as a strike called by Islamic parties has virtually shut down the country, brokers said.
The strike was called to protest against a Jewish woman who pasted up posters in the Israeli town of Hebron depicting the Moslem Prophet Mohammad as a pig.
The strike has virtually paralysed Bangladesh, halting communications and closing down businesses.

"I don't think the trading could take place. We cannot reach the stock exchange because the strike has forced transport off the streets," one broker said. The DSE all-share price index closed 35.86 points or 3.47 percent lower at 996.5 in Monday's trading.
